title: Employer Administration Guide: Member Addition and Termination Reporting for Employer Group Contracts
content:
Employers holding an Employer Group Contract in the Cascade Group Dental & Vision series report each employee addition and each employee termination to Cascade on the following terms.

## Reporting standards

1. The employer must report additions within the segment's member addition reporting window of the qualifying event; a later report takes effect only within the retroactive limits of the group billing arrangement.
2. Coverage of a terminated employee ends on the last day of the month in which employment ended or hours were reduced, and a terminated employee of a group where COBRA applies receives a continuation election notice.
3. Each addition or termination is reported once per employee and effective date; a correction is reported as a new event with the corrected effective date.

## What each report carries

| Report | Carries |
|---|---|
| Addition | the employee's name and date of birth, the entry reason, the coverage tier elected, the hire or qualifying event date, the coverage start date and the report date |
| Termination | the employee's name and date of birth, the reason (employment ended, hours reduced, or dependent aged out), the coverage tier ended, the last day of employment or the event date, the coverage end date and the report date |

A report is identified by the employee, through name and date of birth, and its effective date.

## Coverage end (hypothetical dates)

| Event | Coverage ends |
|---|---|
| Employment ends on April 12 | April 30 |
| Hours are reduced on June 30 | June 30 |
| Employment ends on September 1 | September 30 |

## Points of judgement

- **An addition reported after the reporting window.** It takes effect only within the retroactive limits of the group billing arrangement.
- **The same employee and effective date reported twice.** An addition or termination is reported once per employee and effective date, so the same employee and effective date are not reported a second time.
- **An effective date that was reported wrongly.** The correction is reported as a new event bearing the corrected effective date.
- **A terminated employee of a group where COBRA applies.** The employee receives a continuation election notice.
